mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sekai_Draw_lots_favorite(user_id, character_id, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{characterId}, #{note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sekai_Draw_lots_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND character_id = #{characterId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND character_id = #{characterId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id, c.english_name, NULL AS japanese_name, c.anime_title, c.role_type AS archetype, c.energy AS element, c.image_url, c.tags AS quote, c.popularity_score AS popularity, c.create_time FROM sekai_Draw_lots_favorite f JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_character c ON f.character_id = c.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC
